verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general startup-sponsorship content. A blog post covers whether a startup can sponsor an H-1B and the pitfalls for first-time sponsoring companies, and startups get help choosing visa paths. Nothing documents a founder's own company petitioning for them: no beneficial-ownership rules, no board or employer-control arrangements, and no 2023+ USCIS founder guidance. This is adjacent material, not the capability itself, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance
